title: Vitamin D and immune response
content: Vitamin D supplementation modulates innate and adaptive immune responses and may reduce respiratory infection severity in deficient populations.

title: Hybrid retrieval systems
content: Hybrid search combines dense vector retrieval with sparse BM25 keyword scoring using reciprocal rank fusion to improve recall.

title: SciFact claim verification
content: Scientific claim verification requires retrieving evidence passages that support or refute a given biomedical statement.
